name: Mob Saimin
source:
A character who colors the story and sometimes props up the protagonist, yet is forgettable enough to leave no trace in anyone's memory.

That is... a mob.

The protagonist, Morio Takemochi, is of average height and build with an ordinary face. His grades are neither good nor bad, and the same goes for his athletic ability. He comes from a perfectly ordinary salaryman household, and he had no distinguishing traits at all.

One day, he helps a man in trouble and is handed a suspicious flute that can supposedly change who he is. Half-doubting, he tries it, and it turns out to be the real thing.

Now able to hypnotize anyone within earshot of the flute's sound, Morio uses this power to do as he pleases with the mob women who had never given him a second glance.

And next, of course, he sets his sights on the peerless girls that a mob was never allowed to get involved with...

[Translated from [url=http://crossover-game.jp/include/mobusaimin/story.html]official website[/url]]
